Decoding the PROCTITLE hex: "chmod +x logrotten". The process runs as www-data (uid 33), a web server account, with no login session (auid unset, ses=4294967295), and it is executing chmod +x on a file named "logrotten". "logrotten" is the name of a known Linux privilege escalation exploit (logrotate race condition, CVE-2011-1154 / logrotten by Kali/Ryan Kanan-style PoCs). A web server account making an executable file out of a file with this name strongly suggests post-exploitation activity following a web application compromise.
